welcome: Welcome! I am the WP Care guide. Explore WordPress support, compare plans or send a request for an estimate. Where shall we start?
ask_name:
Step 1 of 4. What is your name?
Next: email, website and task. You can review everything before sending.
ask_email: Step 2 of 4. Which email should we reply to?
invalid_email: That email does not look valid. Please enter it again.
ask_website: Step 3 of 4. Enter your website, e.g. example.com, or tap Skip.
ask_details: Step 4 of 4. What needs changing or fixing? Describe the problem and expected result (up to 1200 characters). You can include a screenshot link. Do not include passwords or access keys.
cooldown: Please wait a moment before sending another request.
not_configured: The request form is not configured yet. Please email wp-care@taldav.com.
send_failed: Delivery could not be confirmed. Your request is kept in this conversation: try sending again or email wp-care@taldav.com. Retrying may create a duplicate.
sent: Thank you! Your request has been sent to the WP Care specialist. We will reply to your email, clarify the task and agree the price before starting.
unknown: I can guide you through WP Care services and terms. Open Common questions, choose a section or tap Request an estimate to ask the specialist.
invalid_name: Enter a name between 1 and 120 characters.
invalid_website: Enter a website address such as https://example.com, or tap Skip.
invalid_details: Describe your task using 1–1200 characters. For a longer description, include a document link.
